reason: Another 25 euros a month on top of all the subscriptions I already pay. The menu changes, sure, but my manager writes it on the board and people come in anyway.
objection: It's one more monthly bill, and I'm not the one who'd use it. My manager would have to keep messaging it, and if they stop, I'm paying for a site nobody updates.
would_change_my_mind: My manager tries it free for a month, actually uses it, and I can see it brought in more customers from Google.
